answer_1.quote: The radiology report is an important tool for radiologists to communicate examination results with other clinicians... writing the impression can be time-consuming and error-prone, which is why automatic text summarization systems can substantially improve the quality of clinical reporting.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of generated impressions with ROUGE F1 to measure unigram and bigram overlap as a proxy for relevance (R-1, R-2) and the longest common subsequence as a proxy for fluency (R-L). In addition, we report BERTScore as a measure of soft-alignment. As factual correctness is critical, we also calculate a factuality F1.

answer_4.quote: We task annotators to highlight erroneous text spans and to classify them according to an error taxonomy... We hired 6 senior medical students in their fifth year of training.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to highlight erroneous text spans and classify them into error categories including omissions, additions, incorrect location, incorrect severity, and other errors. They can also flag any additional errors in free-form.
